thread:
maya: Heads-up 1: RadialEcho is good to go for a short customer vignette and a webinar callout. Need three things: a cleared quote, recording time, and webinar signup routing. Brief: https://drive.redwood.com/radial-echo-brief

samir: I can run the interview. CS are free Wed morning PT, 25-30m. Will prep the customer for a succinct soundbite.

lucy: Producer here  I have Wed 9:30am PT open. Ill set Zoom, Otter for live transcript, and plan a 90s promo cut. What asset sizes do we need?

maya: Great. Target promo: 90-120s for social, plus a 20s teaser. Samir, confirm Wed 9:30 PT?

samir: Confirmed.

kyle-sales: For attendees, can we tag leads by interest so SDRs can follow up? We need a hidden form field for product_interest and utm_campaign=radial-echo-launch. SF queue should be SDR_RadialEcho.

maya: Noted. Kyle please wire up form and lead assignment. Also include a checkbox opt-in for marketing emails.

kyle-sales: Will do. Ill add automation to prioritize MQLs with product_interest=radial_echo.

elaine-legal: Quick notes on copy: we require explicit consent language and any quoted metric should include origin (e.g., aggregated production workload) and timeframe. No comparative claims that imply other vendors without substantiation. Paste the exact quote you want published.

maya: Pasting draft quote and consent below:

"RadialEcho's deployment reduced our inference spend by approximately 45% and brought p95 latency down from ~800ms to ~220ms on our September production workload."    

Consent: "RadialEcho grants Redwood Inference permission to publish the quote and related case study materials (transcript excerpts, short video clips, and summary statistics) for marketing and sales collateral. This approval confirms RadialEchos consent to the use of their name and logo in the case materials."

lucy: Suggest tightening the quote to one short sentence for hero placement. Also ask them to approve the 90s promo clip and the 20s teaser.

samir: I'll request a 1-sentence executive line and explicit consent for the clip. Will send to them after the call.

redwood-bot: FYI: legal-review SLA is 48 hours after submission. Use /legal-review to open a ticket and attach the consent text.

elaine-legal: Once I see the shortened quote I'll check for necessary redlines. If metrics are aggregated and anonymized, no DPA required. If they provided logs, we need a DPA + security questionnaire.

maya: They provided aggregated monthly metrics only. Samir to confirm and attach the reply.

tony: For the launch post draft, I'll lead with the cost & latency wins, then show a 3-bullet benchmark callout, then CTA -> webinar sign-up. I'll prepare two headline variations: technical and customer-facing.

lucy: I'll schedule recording Wed 9:30 PT and include prep notes for the customer (talk track, three talking points, and the ask to approve the short quote on the call).

samir: Reached out to RadialEcho; theyreon it and will send a 1-line quote + consent by EOD.

maya: Action summary:
- Samir: get 1-line exec quote + consent + confirm no raw logs (due EOD)
- Lucy: calendar + recording setup + promo edit plan (done)
- Kyle: form fields and SF queue wiring (SDR_RadialEcho + product_interest + utm)
- Elaine: legal to review once short quote submitted (48h SLA)
- Tony: draft launch post & webinar blurb (share in thread)

elaine-legal: Please make sure the consent includes usage windows if they request an embargo; otherwise standard perpetual marketing use is fine.

maya: Thanks everyone. If legal signs off quickly, target publish next Thursday and schedule webinar within 10 business days after publish.

redwood-bot: Reminder set: /task create "RadialEcho launch assets & legal review" assigned to maya, due in 7 days."
